$comment: Vendor prices (docs/design.md, Combat: water and rust; Health, failure, heat; Progression and economy). The wave-2 vendor at the FiDi coworking desk sells two tank tiers, one flow tier and burritos for runway. Starting values: tank 8 L, flow 0.8 L/s (10 particles/s, so one particle is 0.08 L); maxima 16 L and 1.2 L/s; blaster upgrades $500-8,000; burrito $12 for +2 months of runway; runway never rises above 18 months. Prices are in cents. All values tune.

items.name: Pressure I
items.blurb: Two more metres of reach. The water was never the problem; the distance was.

items.name: Pressure II
items.blurb: Four more metres of reach in all. Stand further back, look braver.

items.name: Flow I
items.blurb: More water per second. Same number of opinions.

items.name: Burrito
items.blurb: Plus two months of runway. Foil included.

items.name: Pour-over
items.blurb: Half a month of runway and a long wait at the counter.
